sloka: हरादवाप्य ते मन्त्रं कामारिमभिवाद्य च ।नारायणालयं प्राप्य तस्मै सर्वं न्यवेदयन् ।। ७.६.३१ ॥
transliteration: harādavāpya te mantraṁ kāmārimabhivādya ca ।nārāyaṇālayaṁ prāpya tasmai sarvaṁ nyavedayan ।। 7.6.31 ॥

translations.english: You should take refuge in that glorious Narayana, also known as Janardana and Hari, who holds the discus and mace in his hands and wears yellow garments.
